text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin continues working part-time jobs and sending money back to her family. It looks like she's doing her best as the older sister of the household.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she's not holding back when it comes to race prep either. And apparently, her coworkers are even helping out by letting her adjust her work schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines is determined to do her best. After all, she's also running for all those who see their hopes and dreams in her.
